question: A store sign is a 5 m × 4 m rectangle with a 2 m × 1 m rectangle cut out. Painting cost is ₹180/m². How much will the painting cost for the exposed area?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total area of the sign = 5 × 4 = 20 m²

Area of cut-out = 2 × 1 = 2 m²

Exposed area to be painted = 20 − 2 = 18 m²

Total painting cost = 18 × 180 = ₹3,240

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,240.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 5 m 4 m 2 m 1 m Cut out Exposed Area 

**Given:**

Dimensions of the full store sign = 5 m × 4 m

Dimensions of the cut-out section = 2 m × 1 m

Rate of painting = ₹180 per m²

**Formula Used:**

Area of a Rectangle = Length × Width

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of the entire store sign = 5 × 4 = 20 m²

⇒ Area of the rectangular cut-out = 2 × 1 = 2 m²

⇒ Exposed Area = Area of store sign − Area of cut-out

⇒ Exposed Area = 20 − 2 = 18 m²

⇒ Cost of painting = Exposed Area × Rate of painting

⇒ Cost of painting = 18 × 180 = 3240

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3,240.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Rectangle

The space occupied by a 2D rectangle is found by the formula: Area = Length × Width.

Area of Composite Figures

The area of a composite shape having a missing portion (cut-out) is determined by calculating the total area of the primary shape and subtracting the exact area of the removed portion.

Total Cost Calculation

The total cost of painting, paving or fencing a specific region is obtained by multiplying the required area (or perimeter) by the designated unit rate. (Cost = Total Area × Unit Rate).
